qualification: Source inventory only, read from files committed at the source revision. It does not prove what a serving image supports; that needs the release's host build identity and its probes. Main at ea4b012 adds 7 ports (sfx-api-content-selection-port.v1, sfx-api-content-receipts-port.v1, sfx-api-content-retained-reference-port.v1, sfx-api-content-projection-port.v1, sfx-api-content-package-port.v1, sfx-api-publication-selection-port.v1, sfx-api-publication-answer-port.v1) and 17 bundle documents. They are not in it: they are extensions, none of them has been qualified by the steps in extensionQualification, and no release has carried them (change-admission.md). Each constraint quotes its source; where a port's behaviour is not summarized, its feature is the statement.

primitives.constraint: One envelope per line, written as UTF-8 with nothing escaped that UTF-8 can carry; the kernel reads at most 8 MiB per line. An envelope a kernel may have begun is never delivered again.
The facade carries out what a directive says, and answers any other with the declared failure response (host/serve.py).
28 capability documents, each pinned by SHA-256 in the manifest; the manifest pinned by the provider authority; both verified in the build context. A change reaches the host only in a new image.
Reads of a capability the bundle owns are answered from the bundle under the pin; every other read passes to sda-kernel-built-in-read.v1.
A bundle document is read only when it is the document the pin names.
Every HTTP request is read by a declared provider, not by the facade.
Every HTTP response is written by a declared provider, not by the facade.
A caller is signed in by a declared provider, and its secrets meet only inside it.
A password's Argon2id tag is derived by a declared provider, as sign-in derives it.
A run's trace is encoded by a declared provider, as the run store's other writers encode it.
Retain hosted execution attempts through declared host providers (features/hosted-acceptance-record.feature).

Positions count from 1 in each channel instance; batches and replay are bounded (channel-batch, channel-retention). The facade holds connections and the channel's buffer and decides nothing itself (approved 2026-11-01).
Runs execute on worker kernels apart from the request kernels, within run-capacity.

extensionQualification: Name the exact behaviour required, the target host build and this inventory's revision.
Retain evidence that composing existing primitives through declarations in the bundle or the estate cannot express it.
Specify the smallest versioned primitive: inputs, effects, authority, refusal and compatibility.
Show that declarations vary over it with no capability-name switch or domain decision in the facade, the providers or the kernel.

A new port, directive verb or facade behaviour is a host implementation change: it ships in a new image and counts under change-admission.md. A new capability composed from existing primitives is not an extension, but a change to the bundle still ships in a new image.
